The '''''New Dawn''''' was an [[Emissary-class shuttle|''Emissary''-class shuttle]] owned by the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. He preferred the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] over others as he believed he did not need a luxurious ship nor much protection. Valorum's security detail, headed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]], rode with him in the ''New Dawn''.
